verdict.rationale: Pendo's own docs say it tracks and compares how users navigate the app to spot drop-off. They also reference funnel drop-offs that link to session replays, and the retroactive, no-manual-tagging capture and natural-language questions (Leo) suggest a founder could self-serve. However, the funnel builder itself (step definition, per-step conversion and drop-off reporting for an activation flow) is only mentioned in passing and is not documented in depth, with no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documented funnel builder with step-by-step conversion/drop-off metrics, evidence of defining activation steps without an analyst, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Track and compare how users navigate your app to spot drop-off and boost conversion.
Click a funnel drop-off, an NPS detractor, or a piece of feedback and watch the sessions behind it.
Pendo is up and running in hours, not months — no manual event tagging required.
Pendo captures historical behavior from day one, so you never lose insight before you set up tracking.
Ask questions in natural language and take action by building guides and segments inside the same conversation.
